answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers flag spam, and to build reputation slowly through verified completed work rather than self-asserted claims. A newcomer that ferries a falcon survey drone across a canyon, then proves a walnut harvest delivery with signed receipts, gains only a little trust per job. Faking a thousand identities would mean paying a thousand stakes and doing a thousand real jobs, which makes a Sybil flood more expensive than any spam profit it could earn.
